description: Draws maps from tabular data (choropleth, proportional symbols, categorical, locator and small multiples) and checks them against cartography rules before exporting SVG, PNG, PDF or interactive HTML. Use it whenever someone asks for a map, a choropleth, "color the countries or states by", a heat map by region, a locator map, or a figure that places numbers on geography. # Spec reference

A spec is one JSON object. Paths are relative to the spec file. Unknown fields produce a warning (`spec-unknown-key`) and are ignored.

## Top level

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | none | Headline. A map without one gets the `title-required` warning. |
| `subtitle` | none | One line under the title: unit, place, period. |
| `source` | none | Where the numbers come from. Required (`source-required`). |
| `note` | none | A short note after the source line, for caveats. |
| `region` | `world` | One of the regions in `references/regions.md`. |
| `type` | `choropleth` | `choropleth`, `symbols`, `categorical`, `locator`, `small-multiples`. |
| `data` | required | The table and which columns to use, see below. |

graticule 0.1.0: maps that pass a checklist, from a small JSON spec.

Usage
  graticule render <spec.json> [-o base] [-f svg,png,pdf,html] [--fix] [--lang xx] [--dpi 300] [--json]
  graticule check  <spec.json> [--fix] [--write] [--lang xx] [--json]
  graticule join   <table.csv> --region <id> [--key column] [--key-type kind] [--json]
  graticule init   <table.csv> --region <id> [--value column] [-o spec.json]
  graticule regions | projections | palettes | rules [--lang xx]

Options
  -o, --out       output base name, or a folder ending in /
  -f, --format    comma separated: svg, png, pdf, html (default svg,png)
  --fix           apply the smallest change that satisfies each failed error rule
  --allow a,b     accept the listed rule ids, with a note in the report
  --lang          map lab
Fill in title, source and data.kind (count, rate, share, index or other) before rendering.
